"""Path-patch validity must be judged against the slot state AFTER restores."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys
ROOT='/workspace'
ENV=dict(os.environ); ENV.update({'PYTHONPATH':ROOT+'/.deps','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':ROOT+'/native','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1'})

def run(req):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',ROOT+'/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode(),capture_output=True,env=ENV)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode().strip()

def case(events):
    return {'cases':[{'nodes':2,'edges':[[0,1,3]],
        'commodities':[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':2,'paths':[None,[0]]}],
        'workers':[[0]],'quorum':1,'max_lag':0,'relax':[1,1],'rho':1,'mode':'route','events':events}]}

cfg = lambda patches: {'op':'configure','mode':'route','capacity':[],'demand':[],'paths':patches}

# legal: withdraw slot 1 first, then repair slot 0
rc,out = run(case([cfg([[0,1,None]]), cfg([[0,0,[0]]]), {'op':'audit'}]))
print('legal sequential patch:', rc, out[:60])
assert rc==0 and out.startswith('{"cases"')

# illegal: repair slot 0 while slot 1 still holds the same path
rc,out = run(case([cfg([[0,0,[0]]]), {'op':'audit'}]))
print('illegal duplicate patch:', rc, out)
assert out=='{"error":"invalid_request"}'

# legal before the checkpoint, illegal after restoring it
rc,out = run(case([cfg([[0,1,None]]), cfg([[0,0,[0]]]), {'op':'save','name':0},
                   {'op':'restore','name':0}, cfg([[0,1,[0]]])]))
print('illegal after restore:', rc, out)
assert out=='{"error":"invalid_request"}'

# illegal before restore, legal after restoring an older (hole-rich) checkpoint
rc,out = run(case([{'op':'save','name':0}, cfg([[0,1,None]]), cfg([[0,0,[0]]]),
                   {'op':'restore','name':0}, cfg([[0,1,None]]), cfg([[0,0,[0]]]), {'op':'audit'}]))
print('legal after restore:', rc, out[:60])
assert rc==0 and out.startswith('{"cases"')

# a restore of a checkpoint whose slots make a later patch duplicate
rc,out = run(case([cfg([[0,1,None]]), {'op':'save','name':1}, cfg([[0,0,[0]]]),
                   {'op':'save','name':2}, {'op':'restore','name':1}, cfg([[0,0,[0]]]),
                   cfg([[0,1,[0]]])]))
print('illegal duplicate after older restore:', rc, out)
assert out=='{"error":"invalid_request"}'
print('restore-aware validation ok')
PYEOF
